svg.title: Pratibimb system architecture
svg.desc: Synthetic EHR (FHIR R4 with ABHA) and wearable/CGM streams from a truth simulator feed the Pratibimb engine: EHR priors, a minimal-model twin kept in sync by an ensemble Kalman filter, ensemble forecasts and a what-if simulator; a LightGBM risk layer with isotonic calibration, TreeSHAP drivers and alert logic; served by FastAPI (REST + WebSocket) or a static export to a Next.js clinician console; evaluated on held-out patients against hidden truth.
svg.text: Pratibimb · hybrid physiology + ML digital twin for Type 2 Diabetes
richer than the twin (no inverse crime)
never shown to the twin or the ML;
used only to score held-out patients
personalised from the record, re-synced every 5 minutes
CGM observations → EnKF update · wearables, meals, doses → model inputs
33 twin features: forecast quantiles, exceedance probabilities, posteriors
Next.js 15 · TypeScript · Tailwind v4 · SVG charts
static demo, or live api + web
36 test patients never used for training or tuning · labels from hidden plasma glucose (CGM-labelled variant too)
All data are synthetic (DPDP Act / HIPAA sandbox). Not a medical device. Recommendations are illustrative.
Pratibimb · Team Stack Underflow · BIT Mesra, Off Campus Jaipur · Apache-2.0
